## Load all packages
```{r}

library("rlang")
library("Seurat");
library("sctransform");
library("dplyr");
library("RColorBrewer");
library("ggthemes");
library("ggplot2");
library("cowplot");
library("data.table");
library("scales")

```


## Set up Seurat object
```{r}

memory.limit(size=50000000)

samples=c("xu45","xu47")

data.10x = list()

data.10x[[1]] <- Read10X(data.dir = "xu45_SM/raw_feature_bc_matrix");

data.10x[[2]] <- Read10X(data.dir = "xu47_SM/raw_feature_bc_matrix");


## Convert each feature-barcode matrix to a Seurat object.

SM.list = list(); 

SM.list[[1]] = CreateSeuratObject(counts = data.10x[[1]], min.cells=3, min.features=200, project=samples[1]);

SM.list[[1]][["DataSet"]] = samples[1];

SM.list[[2]] = CreateSeuratObject(counts = data.10x[[2]], min.cells=3, min.features=200, project=samples[2]);

SM.list[[2]][["DataSet"]] = samples[2];


### Subset each library before merge or integrate


SM.list[[1]] <- subset(SM.list[[1]], subset = nCount_RNA > 5000 & nFeature_RNA > 1000 & nCount_RNA < 150000 & nFeature_RNA < 15000)

SM.list[[2]] <- subset(SM.list[[2]], subset = nCount_RNA > 5000 & nFeature_RNA > 1000 & nCount_RNA < 150000 & nFeature_RNA < 15000)


## logNormalize

SM.list[[1]]<- NormalizeData(SM.list[[1]], normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

SM.list[[2]]<- NormalizeData(SM.list[[2]], normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)


## Find variables


SM.list[[1]]<- FindVariableFeatures(SM.list[[1]], selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

SM.list[[2]]<- FindVariableFeatures(SM.list[[2]], selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)



# Select features that are repeatedly variable across datasets for integration


features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = SM.list)

# find anchors

anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = SM.list, anchor.features = features)


# Integrate data
# this command creates an 'integrated' data assay

SM.int <- IntegrateData(anchorset = anchors)

DefaultAssay(SM.int)<-"integrated"


# Run the standard workflow for visualization and clustering
SM.int <- ScaleData(SM.int, verbose = FALSE)
SM.int <- RunPCA(SM.int, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)


Determine the ‘dimensionality’ of the dataset

ElbowPlot(SM.int, ndims = 40)

## Elbow plot: quantitative approach
## https://hbctraining.github.io/scRNA-seq/lessons/elbow_plot_metric.html


## Determine percent of variation associated with each PC
pct <- SM.int[["pca"]]@stdev / sum(SM.int[["pca"]]@stdev) * 100

# Calculate cumulative percents for each PC
cumu <- cumsum(pct)

# Determine which PC exhibits cumulative percent greater than 90% and % variation associated with the PC as less than 5
co1 <- which(cumu > 90 & pct < 5)[1]

co1


# Determine the difference between variation of PC and subsequent PC
co2 <- sort(which((pct[1:length(pct) - 1] - pct[2:length(pct)]) > 0.1), decreasing = T)[1] + 1

# last point where change of % of variation is more than 0.1%.
co2


# Minimum of the two calculation
pcs <- min(co1, co2)

pcs


```



```{r}
SM.int <- RunUMAP(SM.int, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:pcs) ## Use PC number based on above Elbow plot: quantitative approach


SM.int <- FindNeighbors(SM.int, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:pcs)

SM.int <- FindClusters(SM.int, resolution = 0.8)

# Visualization

DimPlot(SM.int, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, pt.size = 1)
DimPlot(SM.int, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident")

## two plots next to each other 

p1 <- DimPlot(SM.int, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 1)
p2 <- DimPlot(SM.int, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1, label.size = 10)
p1 + p2

### split the UMAPs by samples 

DimPlot(SM.int, reduction = "umap", split.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 1)


### group the UMAPs by samples. 

DimPlot(SM.int, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 1)


## Remove cluster with low UMI or doublet

SM.int_rmDB <- subset(SM.int, idents = c("2", "13"), invert = TRUE)

DimPlot(SM.int_rmDB, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, pt.size = 1)


### split the integrated object to re-normalize and process

SM_int.rmDB.recluster.list <- SplitObject(SM.int_rmDB, split.by = "orig.ident")

SM_int.rmDB.recluster.list


## set RNA assay before normalization and processing 

DefaultAssay(SM_int.rmDB.recluster.list[[1]]) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(SM_int.rmDB.recluster.list[[2]]) <- "RNA"


## logNormalize

SM_int.rmDB.recluster.list[[1]]<- NormalizeData(SM_int.rmDB.recluster.list[[1]], normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

SM_int.rmDB.recluster.list[[2]]<- NormalizeData(SM_int.rmDB.recluster.list[[2]], normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)


## Find variables


SM_int.rmDB.recluster.list[[1]]<- FindVariableFeatures(SM_int.rmDB.recluster.list[[1]], selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

SM_int.rmDB.recluster.list[[2]]<- FindVariableFeatures(SM_int.rmDB.recluster.list[[2]], selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)



# select features that are repeatedly variable across datasets for integration


features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = SM_int.rmDB.recluster.list)


# find anchors

anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = SM_int.rmDB.recluster.list, anchor.features = features)


# Integrate data
# this command creates an 'integrated' data assay

SM_int.rmDB.recluster.int <- IntegrateData(anchorset = anchors)


DefaultAssay(SM_int.rmDB.recluster.int)<-"integrated"


# Run the standard workflow for visualization and clustering
SM_int.rmDB.recluster.int <- ScaleData(SM_int.rmDB.recluster.int, verbose = FALSE)
SM_int.rmDB.recluster.int <- RunPCA(SM_int.rmDB.recluster.int, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)


```

```{r}
## Prepare Subcluster by assigning graph.name="mygraph"

##next run UMAP

DefaultAssay(SM_int.rmDB.recluster.int)<-"integrated"

SM_int.rmDB.recluster.int.subcluster <- FindNeighbors(SM_int.rmDB.recluster.int, graph.name= "mygraph", dims = 1:20)

SM_int.rmDB.recluster.int.subcluster <- FindClusters(SM_int.rmDB.recluster.int.subcluster, graph.name = "mygraph", resolution = 0.8)

SM_int.rmDB.recluster.int.subcluster <- RunUMAP(SM_int.rmDB.recluster.int.subcluster, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:20)


DimPlot(SM_int.rmDB.recluster.int.subcluster, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1, label.size = 10)


```



```{r}
### subcluster cluster 12
SM_int.rmDB.recluster.int.subcluster12 <- FindSubCluster(SM_int.rmDB.recluster.int.subcluster, "12", "mygraph", subcluster.name = "subcluster12",  resolution = 0.3, algorithm = 1)


## Plot the sub-cluster 

p1<- DimPlot(SM_int.rmDB.recluster.int.subcluster12, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 1)

p2<- DimPlot(SM_int.rmDB.recluster.int.subcluster12, reduction = "umap", group.by = "subcluster12", label = TRUE, label.size = 10, pt.size = 1)

p1+p2


saveRDS(SM_int.rmDB.recluster.int.subcluster12, file = "SM_int.rmDB.recluster.int.subcluster12.highres.rds")


```


```{r}
## transfer the subcluster12 labels to be active labels. 

Idents(SM_int.rmDB.recluster.int.subcluster12) <- "subcluster12"


### re-cluster  determinate lateral organ and meristem epidermis cells.

subcluster.lateral.organ.meristem.epi <- subset(SM_int.rmDB.recluster.int.subcluster12, idents = c("11"))

DefaultAssay(subcluster.lateral.organ.meristem.epi)<-"integrated"

subcluster.lateral.organ.meristem.epi <- ScaleData(subcluster.lateral.organ.meristem.epi, verbose = FALSE)

subcluster.lateral.organ.meristem.epi <- RunPCA(subcluster.lateral.organ.meristem.epi, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)


ElbowPlot(subcluster.lateral.organ.meristem.epi, ndims = 40)

## Elbow plot: quantitative approach
## https://hbctraining.github.io/scRNA-seq/lessons/elbow_plot_metric.html

# Determine percent of variation associated with each PC
pct <- subcluster.lateral.organ.meristem.epi[["pca"]]@stdev / sum(subcluster.lateral.organ.meristem.epi[["pca"]]@stdev) * 100

# Calculate cumulative percents for each PC
cumu <- cumsum(pct)

# Determine which PC exhibits cumulative percent greater than 90% and % variation associated with the PC as less than 5
co1 <- which(cumu > 90 & pct < 5)[1]

co1

# Determine the difference between variation of PC and subsequent PC
co2 <- sort(which((pct[1:length(pct) - 1] - pct[2:length(pct)]) > 0.1), decreasing = T)[1] + 1

# last point where change of % of variation is more than 0.1%.
co2


# Minimum of the two calculation
pcs <- min(co1, co2)

pcs


subcluster.lateral.organ.meristem.epi <- RunUMAP(subcluster.lateral.organ.meristem.epi, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:pcs) ## PC number based on above Elbow plot: quantitative approach

subcluster.lateral.organ.meristem.epi <- FindNeighbors(subcluster.lateral.organ.meristem.epi, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:pcs)

subcluster.lateral.organ.meristem.epi <- FindClusters(subcluster.lateral.organ.meristem.epi, resolution = 0.2)

# Visualization

DimPlot(subcluster.lateral.organ.meristem.epi, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, pt.size = 1)
DimPlot(subcluster.lateral.organ.meristem.epi, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident")

## two plots next to each other 

p1 <- DimPlot(subcluster.lateral.organ.meristem.epi, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 1)
p2 <- DimPlot(subcluster.lateral.organ.meristem.epi, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1, label.size = 10)
p1 + p2


subcluster.lateral.organ.meristem.epi <- RenameIdents(object = subcluster.lateral.organ.meristem.epi, '0' = 'Determinate.Lateral.Organ.(epi)', "1" = "Meristem.Epidermis")

p1 <- DimPlot(subcluster.lateral.organ.meristem.epi, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 1)
p2 <- DimPlot(subcluster.lateral.organ.meristem.epi, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1, label.size = 10)
p1 + p2


saveRDS(subcluster.lateral.organ.meristem.epi, file = "subcluster.lateral.organ.meristem.epi.rds")

SM.int.subcluster.final <- SM_int.rmDB.recluster.int.subcluster12

SM.int.subcluster.final$vasculature_Sphase_cortex_pith_subclusters <- as.character(Idents(SM.int.subcluster.final))

SM.int.subcluster.final$vasculature_Sphase_cortex_pith_subclusters[Cells(subcluster.lateral.organ.meristem.epi)] <- paste(Idents(subcluster.lateral.organ.meristem.epi))


DimPlot(SM.int.subcluster.final, reduction = "umap", group.by = "vasculature_Sphase_cortex_pith_subclusters", label = TRUE)

Idents(SM.int.subcluster.final) <- "vasculature_Sphase_cortex_pith_subclusters" ## transfer active labels. 


p1 <- DimPlot(SM.int.subcluster.final, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 1)
p2 <- DimPlot(SM.int.subcluster.final, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1, label.size = 5)
p1 + p2


DimPlot(SM.int.subcluster.final, reduction = "umap",pt.size = 1)

saveRDS(SM.int.subcluster.final.annotate, file = "SM.final.rds")

SM.int.subcluster.final.annotate <- readRDS(file = "SM.final.rds")

```


```{r}
library(Seurat)

## 1) load the already-annotated object
SM.final <- readRDS("SM.final.rds")

## 2) final cluster colors (taken from SM DimPlot)
cluster.colors <- c(
  "Cortex"="#afbca5","Pith"="#99b6ca",
  "S.Phase.(non.epi.I)"="#D4D915","S.Phase.(non.epi.II)"="#95511f",
  "S.Phase.(epi)"="#e9967a",
  "G2.M.Phase.(non.epi.I)"="#737172","G2.M.Phase.(non.epi.II)"="#e761d8",
  "G2.M.Phase.(epi.and.non.epi)"="#808000",
  "Determinate.Lateral.Organ.(epi)"="#98fb98","Determinate.Lateral.Organ.(non.epi)"="#64ac4e",
  "Meristem.Epidermis"="#66dcf6","Meristem.Tip.(stem.cell)"="#e93f33",
  "Meristem.Base"="#f3f550","Meristem.Boundary"="#1FA195",
  "Adaxial.Meristem.Periphery.(non.epi)"="#4d6dcb",
  "Vasculature"="#ffa500","TBD(exp.FCP1.but.not.CLE7)"="#F68282",
  "Stem.epidermis"="#B95FBB")

## 3) check that the saved identities match the color names
cur <- as.character(Idents(SM.final))
print(table(cur))
missing <- setdiff(unique(cur), names(cluster.colors))
if (length(missing) > 0) stop("These labels have no color: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))

## 4) set identity levels in color order
Idents(SM.final) <- factor(cur, levels = names(cluster.colors)[names(cluster.colors) %in% cur])

## 5) store labels, per-cell colors, and the palette in the object
SM.final$final_annotation <- as.character(Idents(SM.final))
SM.final$final_color <- unname(cluster.colors[SM.final$final_annotation])
SM.final@misc$cluster_colors <- cluster.colors

## 6) check the plot, then save under a new name
DimPlot(SM.final, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, label.size = 5, pt.size = 1,
        cols = SM.final@misc$cluster_colors)

saveRDS(SM.final, file = "SM.final.updated.color.rds")

```
